### Blind Loyalty Is Not Servanthood
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/blind-loyalty-is-not-servanthood
Passage: Colossians 1:17-18, 28
Points:
- Cults and abusive religious groups demand unquestioning loyalty and control their followers' minds.
- Discipleship ministries can become authoritarian when excessive devotion is directed toward a human leader.
- True Christian servanthood preserves human dignity, allowing believers to think, ask questions, and serve willingly.
- Faithful leaders consistently redirect followers' attention and worship away from themselves and toward Christ.
- Jesus alone is the preeminent Lord and head of the church who holds everything together.

### There's a Title for That
Author: John UpChurch
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-october-3-2013.html
Passage: Colossians 1:17-18
Points:
- Believers often need fresh reminders of the supremacy and character of Jesus Christ.
- The various biblical titles of Jesus show how He meets every human spiritual need.
- Christ conquered sin, made peace by His sacrifice, and guides believers as their true head.
- As the firstborn from among the dead, Jesus leads the way through suffering into eternal life.
- Because He holds all things together, believers can cling to Him in any circumstance.
